## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: SPY (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -4.62%) BELOW TREND signal stocks over bonds with fear easing.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit stress flagged rising: HYG (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND but HYG/LQD ratio shows stress ↑ (Level: 0.7322 | 1W: +0.10% | 1M: +0.26%). Growth impulse intact: SPY/TLT ↑ (SPY (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND; TLT (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -0.35%) BELOW TREND).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Dollar falling: Dollar Strength (Level: 27.44 | 1W: -1.40% | 1M: -0.87%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND; yield backdrop neutral with TLT BELOW TREND and yield curve near flat (Yield Curve Level: 1.0495 → flat BELOW TREND).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Semis and Tech leadership: SOXX (1W: +13.84% | 1M: +13.08%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +1.69%) ABOVE TREND; Financials showing strength: XLF (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +5.51%) ABOVE TREND. Energy lagging: XLE (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%) CORRECTION — style: Growth/momentum leading with cyclicals participation.

5. US vs Global?  
US participation robust: SPY (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND while EM leadership is notable: EEM (1W: +7.02% | 1M: +2.94%) ABOVE TREND; China mixed: FXI (1W: +1.94% | 1M: -0.41%) RECOVERY.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Risk-on tilt: IBIT (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +3.98% | 1M: +3.53%) ABOVE TREND show speculative appetite; ARKK (1W: +1.06% | 1M: -5.17%) RECOVERY signals selective rotation within alpha strategies.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Base metals/Copper strength: CPER (1W: +4.36% | 1M: -0.69%) RECOVERY supporting reflation signals; Gold in RECOVERY: GLD (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -8.21%) RECOVERY — defensive bid but lagging equities.

8. Energy Trend?  
Oil volatility: BNO (1W: -12.69% | 1M: +7.29%) CORRECTION and USO (1W: -9.50% | 1M: +15.52%) CORRECTION show whipsaw; XLE (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%) CORRECTION and UNG (1W: -5.11% | 1M: -16.38%) BELOW TREND — watch commodity dispersion.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Broad sector breadth (9/11) and leadership in Tech/Semiconductors (XLK, SOXX ABOVE TREND) validate the RISK-ON signal. DIVERGENCE: credit ratio showing stress ↑ despite HYG/LQD modest gains and energy weakness vs cyclicals — monitor for credit-led hesitation.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor cyclicals and growth exposure: XLK (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +1.69%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +13.84% | 1M: +13.08%) ABOVE TREND, EEM (1W: +7.02% | 1M: +2.94%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to energy beta XLE (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%) CORRECTION and watch credit signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Semiconductors (SOXX (1W: +13.84% | 1M: +13.08%) ABOVE TREND) and Small Caps (IWM (1W: +3.98% | 1M: +3.53%) ABOVE TREND).  
BEARISH: Energy (XLE (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%) CORRECTION) and select commodity-exposed names showing 1W/1M divergence (USO, BNO CORRECTION).

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Copper/industrial metals (CPER (1W: +4.36% | 1M: -0.69%) RECOVERY).  
BEARISH: Natural gas (UNG (1W: -5.11% | 1M: -16.38%) BELOW TREND) and volatile crude swings (BNO (1W: -12.69% | 1M: +7.29%) CORRECTION).

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~30 (VXX (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -4.62%) BELOW TREND) as a fear pivot, HYG/LQD ratio ~0.73 (Level: 0.7322 | 1W: +0.10% | 1M: +0.26%) for credit health, XLK/XLF ~2.81 (Tech vs Financials Level: 2.8091 | 1W: +2.44% | 1M: -0.87%) for style leadership.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive.  
Semiconductors and Tech (SOXX (1W: +13.84% | 1M: +13.08%) ABOVE TREND; XLK (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +1.69%) ABOVE TREND) and EM (EEM (1W: +7.02% | 1M: +2.94%) ABOVE TREND) showing strength.  
Key risk: credit stress flagged rising (HYG/LQD ratio ↑) and energy divergence (XLE (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%) CORRECTION) — monitor credit and commodity whipsaws.
